scope: Joint immutable case/source/effect and private worker admission; provisional inward command contract implemented, bounded product/watch/frontend integration pending. Not a stable public/persisted ABI or full DE-W034 admission.
definition: Exact case operation/revision, current native source binding and typed support effect definition are frozen together under org.disked.acquisition-case-export-definition-prototype/1. Reconstruct selected case/resources/policy/artifact and destination/producer and compare all fields before execution; a supplied digest or JSON is no actor authentication. The exact source read binding, ancestry generations and raw metadata hashes are private routing/review evidence, never support artifact content.
review: Strict provisional schema urn:disked:schema:acquisition-case-export-definition:1. Automatic semantic bounds/relations complement types. Reviewed source profile is read, the final ancestor equals its original store generation, names are exactly acquisition.request/acquisition.records, metadata is ordinary single-link, and case revisions agree. Native reconstruction additionally binds original store, exact raw history digest/size and typed selected artifact. A structurally valid changed definition still cannot bypass fresh native comparison. No recorded source/destination/map path is followed.
grant: Exact joint definition_digest and case_read, report_write, host_effects explicitly true. Check supplied execute authority before reconstructing native resources. Inward execution refuses missing/mismatched authority before source/effect port calls. These flags are declarations, not authenticated approvals. One native session allows one execution; no implicit retry, overwrite, cleanup or force.
revalidation: Retain the read-only source and producer/destination pins. Check exact source binding before effect entry and before each native resource observation, creation, write, flush, read and size observation. A source-check failure before entering creation proves that call created nothing; after creation retain actual output/receipt/counters. Reobserve source after effect execution. These are finite observations, not an atomic multi-resource transaction or privileged-writer fence. Metadata-only changes remain possible and must invalidate applicability.
outcome: Separate joint status/source_state from the full output outcome/receipt. A late source mismatch or unavailable observation after a completed output makes joint completion fail while retaining output completion, exact verification counters and receipt. An effect-executor exception is unknown with uncertain output and unknown written count, never a fabricated no-effect refusal. Revalidation failure cannot erase an actual created file. Retain partial files and their bytes on failure/cancellation; no automatic restart on a timed-out effect.
qualification: Actual generated acquisition input with independently verified source/copy/map; real prepare/reconstruct/execute with no output during preparation, all-policy definition changes, actual metadata generation changes before/after creation, no-clobber races, cancellation and exact output receipts/bytes. Pure modeled source/late-effect faults are labeled separately. No physical devices, elevation, customer data or publication.
next_gate: Qualify bounded product dispatch, report operation inspect/cancel/watch and actual CLI/stdio/GUI/TUI/shell journeys using the defined provisional export-command profile before product availability. Preserve exact case/source/effect/worker/store bindings, uncertainty and separate authenticated custody, current acquired-image, physical/platform and owner/release gates.
worker_admission: See report-worker-prototype.json for separate store/code/host effects, bounded same-executable role, durable attempts/cancellation and uncertain late results.
